definitions.explanation: Feeling drowsy and wanting to sleep. A variant of {眠|ねむ}い with the same meaning.

examples.japanese: ねむたい⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧こする。
⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{寝|ね}なかった→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦すごく→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧ねむたい。
examples.english: I didn't sleep much yesterday, so I'm really sleepy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧ねむたく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I always get sleepy during afternoon classes.

notes:
FORMS:
- Adverbial: ねむたく
- Negative: ねむたく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧
- Past: ねむたかった

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{眠|ねむ}い→眠い：00872_nemui⟧: sleepy (standard form)
- ねむたい: sleepy (variant, slightly more colloquial)

Both have the same meaning. ⟦{眠|ねむ}い→眠い：00872_nemui⟧ is the standard dictionary form and more widely used. ねむたい is heard more in casual speech and in certain regional dialects (especially Kansai).

WRITING:
Can be written as {眠|ねむ}たい. The kanji form {眠|ねむ} is the same as in ⟦{眠|ねむ}い→眠い：00872_nemui⟧.
